messages:
jordan-finance: Aurora Data (acct AD-321) outstanding INV-2026-089 for $6,750. Sent dunning twice, second notice bounced. Need next steps — pause service or payment plan? @kevin-am @anjali-collections

mira-cs: Client replied in-thread saying card failed and they're switching banks. Asks for a 10-day grace and says they can pay by ACH.

kevin-am: Confirmed: CFO at Aurora promised ACH within 10 business days but asked that we keep ingestion pipeline live. They offered to put a $2k deposit now by card while ACH clears.

anjali-collections: We can accept deposit + ACH, but need PoP and a signed payment agreement. Recommend suspend after 5 days of missed ACH settlement. No fee waivers unless exec approves.

nora-legal: I can prepare a short amendment for signature. Suggest we include charge authorization for the deposit and rollback clause if ACH fails.

jordan-finance: Invoice details: INV-2026-089 issued 2026-02-20, due 2026-03-22, amount $6,750. Proposed: $2,000 deposit within 48 hrs, ACH for remaining $4,750 by 2026-04-05.

payment-bot: Notice: payment attempt on card ending 6789 failed at 2026-03-24T09:14:12Z. Next retry scheduled in 24h.

kevin-am: Client asked if we can remove the 1.5% late processing fee if deposit posts.

anjali-collections: Fee waiver needs CFO sign-off. Also require card on file as fallback. If ACH doesn't clear by 2026-04-06, we suspend ingestion and open collections.

cfo: Approve conditional waiver of 1.5% processing fee if $2k deposit posts and executed amendment is returned within 72 hours. Finance to confirm cleared funds before removing fee.

jordan-finance: I'll draft the amendment and send to kevin for client signature. Link: https://console.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-089/amendment (will attach POPs).

kevin-am: Sending amendment to client now. I'll upload remittance once ACH initiated.

mira-cs: Client messaged: wiring tomorrow morning, will share SWIFT receipt.

anjali-collections: Once wire or POP arrives, I'll mark invoice as "on plan" and hold suspension. If nothing by 2026-04-06, we proceed with suspension and escalate to external collections.

jordan-finance: Timeline noted. I'll watch for funds and update ledger. Thanks. :thumbsup:
